sequence_analysis.reason: Exactly one row per vehicle_id and one row per battery_serial; cycle_count is a single scalar per vehicle, not a repeated cycle history.

suspicious_values: One row per vehicle_id and per battery_serial; no chronological cycle history.
Negative ambient/minimum/maximum temperatures are physically valid, not errors.
internal_resistance and remaining_capacity have no declared source units; remaining_capacity is not pack Ah derived from kWh and pack voltage.
capacity_loss_percent is exactly 100 minus battery_health_percent where both exist.
state_of_health and battery_health_percent are near-duplicates but not identical and have different missing counts.
predicted_remaining_life_cycles is a model-provided prediction, not measured RUL.

battery_failure.description: Binary battery-failure label provided by the source dataset.

battery_health_percent.description: SOH percentage; audited independently of state_of_health. capacity_loss_percent is exactly 100 minus this field.

state_of_health.description: SOH percentage; audited independently of battery_health_percent.

sequence_analysis.reason: Exactly one row per cell_id; cycle_number is a single snapshot value per cell, so no chronological history can be reconstructed.

suspicious_values: Exactly one row per cell_id; cycle_number is a snapshot, not a history.
projected_cycle_life_80pct_soh is projected, and for some rows it is below the current cycle_number.
degradation_risk_tier is deterministically aligned with SOH bands.
thermal_stability_margin_c is exactly thermal_runaway_onset_c minus operating_temperature_c.
cot_electrochemical_risk_rationale restates SOH, cycle number and risk tier; it is generated text.
confidence_score and the enriched risk scores have undocumented derivation.

degradation_risk_tier.description: Provided risk tier. It is derived from SOH and other signals, so it is a target for risk classification but never an input feature.

sequence_analysis.reason: 1,978 battery IDs across 2,000 rows; at most two snapshots per battery, and some repeated IDs carry conflicting electrolyte labels, so no reliable chronological sequence exists.

suspicious_values: Synthetic origin; not observational field data.
state_of_health is categorical only; no numeric SOH or measured RUL exists.
Some battery_id values repeat with different electrolyte labels and different cycle snapshots.
Labels are strongly associated with discharge capacity, resistance and cycle count, consistent with generated thresholds.

state_of_health.description: Categorical SOH label (Healthy, Degraded, End_of_Life). No numeric SOH or measured RUL is provided or invented.
